title: Torium
description: A super fast and easy to use Performance Modpack!
body:
Torium is a lightweight performance-focused Minecraft modpack designed to deliver stable FPS and TPS while preserving the vanilla experience.

Every mod included has been carefully selected to provide meaningful performance improvements without changing gameplay, world generation, progression, or game mechanics. Whether you're running Minecraft on older hardware or a modern gaming PC, Torium helps create a smoother, more responsive experience with reduced stuttering, faster loading times, and improved overall stability.

Unlike many optimization packs, Torium contains no content mods, no gameplay additions, and no unnecessary features. The goal is simple: Minecraft, but faster.

Why Choose Torium?
Significantly improved FPS
More stable TPS on singleplayer and servers
Faster game startup and world loading
Reduced memory usage
Better chunk loading performance
Improved rendering efficiency
Safe for existing worlds
Vanilla-friendly experience
Shader support included
Included Optimization Technologies

Torium combines some of the most trusted optimization mods available for Minecraft 1.20.1:

### Rendering Optimizations
- Embeddium – Modern renderer that dramatically improves FPS.
  
- ImmediatelyFast – Optimizes GUI, particles, entities, and block rendering.
  
- EntityCulling – Prevents rendering entities hidden behind blocks.
  
- Better Clouds – Improved cloud rendering with better performance.
  
- ModelFix – Fixes model-related rendering inefficiencies.
  
- Chloride – Additional rendering optimizations for smoother gameplay.
  
- GPU Tape – Reduces GPU bottlenecks and improves rendering diagnostics.
  
### Memory & Stability Improvements.

- FerriteCore – Greatly reduces memory usage.
 
- ModernFix – Massive collection of bug fixes, startup improvements, and memory optimizations.
  
- Memory Leak Fix – Prevents several known memory leaks.
  
- Saturn – Optimizes memory allocation and performance.
  
- Flerovium – Improves internal game performance and stability.
  
- World & Chunk Performance

- Starlight – Rewrites Minecraft's lighting engine for dramatically faster lighting calculations.

- Canary – Optimizes block updates and world ticking.

- Ksyxis – Speeds up world generation and chunk loading.

- Chunky – Pre-generates chunks to reduce lag during exploration.

- Let Me Despawn – Improves entity management and mob despawning behavior.

### Startup & Loading Improvements
- Smooth Boot Reloaded – Improves CPU utilization during startup.
  
- RRLS (Remove Reloading Screen) – Reduces resource reload interruptions.
  
- Packet Fixer – Resolves networking-related issues and improves compatibility.
  
- Quality of Life & Compatibility
  
- Dynamic FPS – Reduces resource usage while Minecraft is in the background.
  
- Oculus – Shader support for Forge and NeoForge.
  
- YACL (Yet Another Config Lib) and Cloth Config – Configuration support for included mods.
  
- Rubidium Extra – Additional performance settings and visual customization options.
  
- Cube Without Borders – Improved fullscreen and borderless window support.
  
- Boat Item View – Small visual enhancement with negligible performance impact.
  
### Important Information for the (Neo)Forge Version

⚠️ DO NOT update Nvidium (NeoForge). Updating Nvidium will cause Minecraft to crash.

⚠️ DO NOT install Sodium Extras. Sodium Extras is incompatible with Torium and will crash your game.

⚠️ Want to play with Create?
Download the dedicated Create-compatible version of Yappadium, or remove Radium from the mod list before installing Create.

Tested Hardware

Torium is actively tested on:

CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 9600X 6-Core Processor
GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16GB

While tested on modern hardware, Torium is specifically designed to benefit systems across a wide range of specifications.

Future Updates

Torium will continue receiving updates for newer Minecraft versions as optimization mods become available and stable. Every update prioritizes reliability, compatibility, and performance improvements while maintaining the vanilla Minecraft experience.

Experience Minecraft as you remember it but only faster.
